alt: A comic depicts talking stuffed animals. A stuffed animal in a bonnet lays on the ground. A dog stands above it. What have I done? Animal? Please start breathing. Oh god, please breathe. Haha, ok, make-believe time is over! Oh god oh god oh god oh god oh god oh god... what will nanny do to me if she finds out? No one can ever know. I have to hide the body. But where? Think, imagination! Argh, the one time I really need you!! Click. The light turns on. They slowly turn around. Hello Rowlf. I want to play a game.
